businessProblem: A large Indian renewable energy company and wind turbine manufacturer has referred its debt to the Corporate Debt Restructuring cell on 29 October 2012. The company faces severe balance-sheet pressure: net debt to equity of 2.9x as of June 2012, significant foreign currency liabilities including FCCBs with a holder extension request that did not pass and discussions still ongoing, negative EBIT margins of -7% on H1 FY13 revenue of INR 10,449 crore, and constrained working-capital facilities that are adversely affecting business operations. Rupee depreciation has increased pressure on largely unhedged foreign-currency obligations. Management has stated that FY13 strategic focus is comprehensive liability management. The company is seeking a moratorium on principal and interest on term debt, a longer repayment profile, and interest concessions through the CDR process. Diagnose the root causes of the distress and recommend the highest-priority action plan available to management at this decision point.

evidence.finding: Net debt to equity ratio of 2.9x as of 30 June 2012, indicating high leverage relative to equity base
H1 FY13 revenue of INR 10,449 crore with EBIT margin of negative 7%, indicating operating losses at the current business scale
Significant foreign currency liabilities including FCCBs outstanding; foreign currency obligations are largely unhedged
Rupee depreciation has increased the effective burden of largely unhedged foreign-currency debt obligations in rupee terms
FCCB holder extension request did not pass; discussions with FCCB holders are continuing at the decision date
Constrained working-capital facilities are adversely affecting business operations at the decision date
Company's stated FY13 strategic focus is comprehensive liability management, reflecting management's own assessment that debt restructuring is the primary priority

Company has referred debt to the Corporate Debt Restructuring cell on 29 October 2012 and is seeking moratorium on principal and interest on term debt, longer repayment profile, and interest concessions
